name: obsidian-bridge
description: Mirrors each Claude session into an Obsidian note and takes replies that you write in that note.

enabled.title: Mirror sessions
enabled.description: Make a note for each session. You can also use /obsidian off in one session.

vault.title: Vault name
vault.description: The name of the Obsidian vault, as the Obsidian CLI knows it. Empty uses the name of the vault folder.

vaultPath.title: Vault folder
vaultPath.description: The absolute path of the vault. Empty finds it from the Obsidian vault list.

folder.title: Notes folder
folder.description: The folder in the vault for the session notes.

cli.title: Obsidian CLI
cli.description: The path of the Obsidian CLI. Empty tries the usual places.

pollSeconds.title: Reply check interval (seconds)
pollSeconds.description: How often Claude reads the note for a reply.

settleSeconds.title: Settle time (seconds)
settleSeconds.description: The reply area must stay the same for this time before Claude takes the message.

flushSeconds.title: Work log interval (seconds)
flushSeconds.description: How often Claude writes the collected tool steps into the note.
